text: The deletion test follow-up explicitly removes virtual and underlying folders at cleanup so repeated --verify runs can reuse fixture names. Its message still reports a failure rather than proving the intermittent issue fixed. Current source also waits a frame before localized-count assertions. Preserve both cleanup and UI-readiness contracts, and report the actual verify run separately; none was executed here. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Keep repeatable fixture cleanup separate from the flaky assertion
